name: zsh-wordsplit-guard
description: Catches Bash commands that run differently under zsh: expansions zsh does not word-split (`for x in $var`, a stored command run as `$DC build`), words it expands where bash keeps them literal (`=word`, a glob in `--flag=*.md` or a URL query, `$name:` modifiers, `(…)` in `${v/pattern/…}`), bash-only `${!name}` and `${v@Q}`, and assignments to `path` or `status`. Literal words are rewritten; the rest are denied, naming the zsh form. The split rules opt out with `[nosplit]` or ALLOW_ZSH_NOSPLIT=1.
